diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_cloudtrail.main` references only the bucket id (`s3_bucket_name = aws_s3_bucket.cloudtrail.id`), so nothing forces `:resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cloudtrail` (which grants cloudtrail.amazonaws.com s3:GetBucketAcl / s3:PutObject) to be applied first. If the trail is created while the bucket policy is absent, CloudTrail's CreateTrail call fails with InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException. Per the provider docs' basic example, `aws_cloudtrail` must depend on the S3 bucket policy (`depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.cloudtrail]`); there is no attribute reference that can express this, since the bucket policy resource exports no attributes usable by the trail.
